title: Novena to St. Jude
description: A nine-day prayer for desperate causes and situations that seem hopeless. St. Jude is the patron saint of lost causes and desperate situations.
intention: For desperate situations, lost causes, and when hope seems distant
instructions: Pray this novena for 9 consecutive days with faith and devotion. Many people pray this novena when facing seemingly impossible situations, job loss, illness, family problems, or any desperate circumstances. Include your personal intentions during each day of prayer.
background_info: St. Jude was one of the twelve apostles of Jesus Christ. He is often depicted holding an image of Jesus, representing the letter he carried from Jesus to King Abgar. He was martyred for his faith around 65 AD in Persia. Because his name is similar to Judas Iscariot, he was often overlooked in prayer, earning him the title of patron of lost causes.

days.title: Day 1: Seeking Hope in Desperation
days.opening_prayer: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
days.daily_prayer: Most holy Apostle St. Jude, faithful servant and friend of Jesus, the Church honors and invokes you universally as the patron of difficult cases, of things almost despaired of. Pray for me, I am so helpless and alone. Intercede with God for me that He bring visible and speedy help where help is almost despaired of. Come to my assistance in this great need that I may receive the consolation and help of heaven in all my necessities, tribulations, and sufferings, particularly in [mention your request], and that I may praise God with you and all the saints forever. I promise, O blessed St. Jude, to be ever mindful of this great favor granted me by God and to always honor you as my special and powerful patron, and to gratefully encourage devotion to you. Amen.
days.closing_prayer: St. Jude, pray for us and all who invoke your aid.
days.reflection: Today we begin our journey of faith with St. Jude. In desperate times, we often feel alone and forgotten. St. Jude reminds us that no situation is truly hopeless when we place our trust in God's mercy and power.
days.intention_prayer: St. Jude, I place my intentions before you: [pause for personal intentions]. Help me to trust in God's plan, even when I cannot see the way forward.
days.scripture: "Ask and it will be given to you; seek and you will find; knock and the door will be opened to you." - Matthew 7:7

days.reflection: St. Jude understood impossible circumstances. As an apostle, he faced persecution, rejection, and ultimately martyrdom. Yet he never lost faith in God's power to work miracles. Today, let us ask for the grace to maintain faith even in our darkest hours.
days.intention_prayer: St. Jude, strengthen my faith when circumstances seem impossible. Help me to see God's hand working in ways I cannot yet understand.
days.scripture: "Jesus looked at them and said, 'With man this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.'" - Matthew 19:26

days.reflection: Persistent prayer is not about wearing God down, but about aligning our hearts with His will. St. Jude's intercession reminds us that some answers come only through sustained prayer and faith. Do not grow weary in your petition.
days.intention_prayer: St. Jude, help me to persevere in prayer even when I don't see immediate results. Give me patience to wait on God's timing.
days.scripture: "Then Jesus told his disciples a parable to show them that they should always pray and not give up." - Luke 18:1

days.closing_prayer: St. Jude, pray for us and all who invoke your aid.
days.reflection: Divine Providence means trusting that God's care extends to every detail of our lives, especially in our greatest needs. St. Jude knew that Jesus would provide for His apostles, even in the most challenging missions.
days.intention_prayer: St. Jude, help me to trust completely in God's providence. Even if His answer is different from what I expect, help me to accept His will with peace.
days.scripture: "And we know that in all things God works for the good of those who love him, who have been called according to his purpose." - Romans 8:28

days.closing_prayer: St. Jude, pray for us and all who invoke your aid.
days.reflection: True humility recognizes our complete dependence on God's mercy and grace. Like St. Jude, we approach God not with demands but with humble hearts, knowing that every good gift comes from above.
days.intention_prayer: St. Jude, teach me to approach God with humility. Help me to surrender my will to His, trusting in His infinite wisdom and love.
days.scripture: "Humble yourselves, therefore, under God's mighty hand, that he may lift you up in due time." - 1 Peter 5:6

days.closing_prayer: St. Jude, pray for us and all who invoke your aid.
days.reflection: Faith includes gratitude for what God will do, not just what He has done. St. Jude's faith was so strong that he could thank God for victories not yet seen. Let us cultivate this spirit of advance gratitude.
days.intention_prayer: St. Jude, help me to thank God in advance for His answer to my prayers, whatever form it may take. Fill my heart with gratitude and trust.
days.scripture: "Give thanks in all circumstances; for this is God's will for you in Christ Jesus." - 1 Thessalonians 5:18

days.closing_prayer: St. Jude, pray for us and all who invoke your aid.
days.reflection: The spiritual life requires strength for the long journey. St. Jude traveled far and faced many hardships spreading the Gospel. He draws from the same divine strength that can sustain us through our trials.
days.intention_prayer: St. Jude, give me strength for this journey of faith. When I am weary, refresh my spirit. When I am discouraged, renew my hope.
days.scripture: "But those who hope in the Lord will renew their strength. They will soar on wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary, they will walk and not be faint." - Isaiah 40:31

days.reflection: We are not alone in our struggles. The communion of saints, led by intercessors like St. Jude, surrounds us with prayer and support. We are part of a vast family of faith that spans heaven and earth.
days.intention_prayer: St. Jude, thank you for joining your prayers to mine. Help me to remember that I am surrounded by the love and intercession of all the saints.
days.scripture: "Therefore, since we are surrounded by such a great cloud of witnesses, let us throw off everything that hinders and the sin that so easily entangles." - Hebrews 12:1

days.reflection: As we complete this novena, we remember the promise made to St. Jude to be mindful of his intercession and to encourage devotion to him. Whether our specific petition is granted or not, we have grown in faith and trust through these nine days.
days.intention_prayer: St. Jude, I thank you for these nine days of prayer. Help me to keep my promise to honor you and to share your powerful intercession with others who face desperate situations.
days.scripture: "Let us hold unswervingly to the hope we profess, for he who promised is faithful." - Hebrews 10:23

source: Traditional Catholic Novena to St. Jude
notes: This novena is traditionally prayed for nine consecutive days. Many people share testimonies of St. Jude's powerful intercession in desperate situations. After completing the novena, it is customary to share the prayer with others and to honor St. Jude through acts of devotion and charity.
